pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   D. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   D. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   C. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   C. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Dynasties: Rise of the Umayyad Dynasty Selected Umayyad Caliphs: Muawiya  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Dynasties and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Tanzania and Uganda 4.3 Muslim scholars . Page 16 of 80 1 STRAND 1.0: S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. B — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim Dynasties; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
